mlp_delta.criterion: at least 4/5 folds improve inner-log monitor loss by >=5% and median best epoch > 0

mlp_delta_strong.criterion: at least 4/5 folds improve inner-log monitor loss by >=5% and median best epoch > 0

mlp_raw.criterion: at least 4/5 folds improve inner-log monitor loss by >=5% and median best epoch > 0

crossfit.outer_validation_feature_policy: model fit only on all outer-train logs

feature_contract.current_actor_source: planning-instant GT annotations; structured-perception upper bound

interpretation.candidate_source: deterministic expert-anchor perturbation bank; trajectory source is not used as a model input label
interpretation.current_limit: current actor state uses annotations, not a learned visual perception stack
interpretation.what_is_not_predicted: static map/route geometry, which is computed exactly online

overfit_capacity_sanity.interpretation: in-sample implementation/capacity sanity only; not evidence of held-out prediction quality

predictor_fidelity_gate.reason: Downstream no-gain cannot reject the method unless this prediction-fidelity gate passes.

primary_effect_model_selection.criterion: maximize outer-train OOF candidate-delta Spearman, then outer-train OOF pairwise-distance Spearman
